Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this nail-biting game. Ireland have sealed the series and would like to complete a whitewash in the third and final game of this ODI series. Join us for that one on 7th July, Sunday. That match will begin 1045 Local (0945 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

Earlier in the day, Stirling's 52 along with maiden ODI 50s from McCollum and Tucker took the hosts to a fighting and eventually a winning total of 242. Solomon Mire was the star bowler for Zimbabwe picking up a 4-fer.

Tim Murtagh! The star of the day. When 15 runs are required off the last 2 overs and there are two set batsmen. 9 times out of 10 the team chasing will win it. The one occasion they won't is when someone bowls an exceptional over. That's exactly what Tim did. He gave away just a single run in the game's penultimate over and also got rid of Donald Tiripano, completely changing the tide of the game. He provided Ireland the early breakthrough they needed earlier in the innings. His consistent lines and lengths were rewarded with wickets. Tim held his nerves in the crunch stages and ended up getting his maiden ODI 5-fer. Shane Getkate and Boyd Rankin with their 2 and 1 wicket apiece were the other two bowler's to get into the wickets column. That was enough for the hosts to take an unassailable lead in the series.

Donald Tiripano and Ryan Burl stuck around. They started their fight slowly. Facing off the tough balls but then the duo started accelerating. They played out the good balls but managed to score boundaries off the bad balls. The latter even managed to score his maiden 50 but it was not enough as Zimbabwe fell short at the last hurdle.

Chasing 243, Zimbabwe's chase did not get off to a good start. They lost both the openers and Brendon Taylor very early in the innings. Craig Ervine and Sean Williams did show fight but the former fell at the wrong time. Williams then hung around with Raza as Sikandar played a quick fire cameo of 31 off just 22 balls but once he fell, Williams too followed soon after getting to his 50. At 160/7 it looked like all was done but then came Tiripano.
WHAT A THRILLER! In the end Ireland managed to hold their nerves and get over the line but spare a thought for Ryan Burl. He showed fight, courage but it just wasn't enough.
Full toss but Chatara cannot make the most of it. He hits it wide of sweeper cover but all along the ground. He gets just a single. IRELAND WIN BY 5 RUNS.

FOUR! Pulled with disdain! Adair bowls one short on the body and Ervine is already camping on the back foot. He reads the length early and pulls it over the infield to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Ervine once again defends this fuller one off the back foot to the bowler.
Fuller one on middle, Ervine defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads, Ervine flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Ervine slaps it to covers.
On a good length on middle, Williams defends it off the back foot. 5 runs have come from the over.
Full on off, Ervine drives it towards mid off where the fielder does well to stop it. The batsmen still manage to take a single.
Length delivery on off, Ervine plays it to point.
Full on off, Ervine drives it straight back towards the bowler where Murtagh tries to stop it but misses it and hits the stumps at his end.
FOUR! Classic shot. Full on middle, Ervine drives it through mid on for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Ervine blocks it off the back foot.
On a good length on off, Williams plays it to mid off.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Williams offers no shot to this one.
On a good length on middle, Williams defends it out.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short of a length delivery, Williams pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, Ervine pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls a quick short ball, Ervine looks to get away from the ball but gets hit on the hand.
On a good length on off, Ervine defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Sean punches it to cover. End of an excellent over from Murtagh. Double wicket maiden for Tim.
Outside off on a length, Williams shoulders arms to it.
No hat-trick for Murtagh. He bowls it full on off, Sean pushes it to mid off to deny Tim of a hat-trick.
Sean Williams is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Murtagh is on a roll here! Two in two for him and now he is on a hat-trick. Length ball pitching around off, it jags back in sharply, Taylor looks to defend but the ball hits him flush on the pads right before the stumps. The Irish players put in a confident appeal and the umpire raises his fingers. Golden Duck for Brendon Taylor and Zimbabwein deep trouble here.
Brendan Taylor is the new batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Excellent delivery from Tim Murtagh. He bowls it on a good length and just outside off, Mire looks to defend but gets an outside edge due to the inward movement on this one. It goes towards Lorcan Tucker who takes a comfortable catch.
Length delivery on off, Mire punches it to covers.
Good length ball on off, Ervine punches it to mid on.
Bowls it outside off, Craig shoulders arms to it.

FOUR! First boundary for Ervine and this is a shot of a confident man. Remember he is coming into this one on the back of a solid century. Slightly overpitched on middle and leg, Ervine drives this through mid on for a boundary.
Good length ball outside off. It is on the fourth stump line, Ervine leaves  it alone.
WIDE! This one is way outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided.
Good length ball outside leg drifts to the off stump. Ervine defends it back to the bowler
Full on off, Ervine drives it towards mid off for a run. Just 1 run from the over. Good bowling from Murtagh.
BEATEN FOR THE THIRD TIME! On a good length and outside off, Ervine looks to play inside the line but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Play and a miss! Good length delivery outside off, Ervine looks to chase this delivery but misses it. Craig Ervine is looking tentative here.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Ervine looks to defend but misses it due to the outward movement on this one.
On a good length on off, Ervine plays it to covers.
Outside off, Ervine leaves it alone.
EDGE AND FOUR! On a good length on off, Mire looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes past second slip towards third man for a boundary.
Full on off, Mire drives it to mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Mire lets it go.
Outside off, Mire shoulders his arms to this one.
On a good length on off, Mire defends it off the front foot.
Adair starts with a good length ball and just outside off, Mire looks to defend but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Mark Adair to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Beauty to finish! Good length ball pitching on middle and off, Ervine looks to defend but the ball moves away from the right-hander and just goes past the outside edge.
Craig Ervine is the new batsman in.

Out! Bowled! This ball is a pacers dream. Murtagh pitches the ball on length, the fourth stump line and it nips just back inside for Masakadza and clips the top of off stump and flicks the bails off them. First blow for Zimbabwe!
On top of off, Hamilton defends it to cover.
Beautiful reply by the bowler! The ball pitches on the fourth stump line, drifts away and beats Masakdza.
FOUR! The run chase is off the mark and that too in style. Back of a length ball on off, Masakadza gets on his back foot and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Murtagh starts the innings with a fuller ball on off, Masakadza defends it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of his bat.

We are back for the chase. The Ireland players are out in the middle. Hamilton Masakadza and Solomon Mire will open the batting for Zimbabwe. Tim Murtagh will start the proceedings for Ireland with the first new ball.
